content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I'm facing an issue with a project created in [product_name] [version_no]. When I try to open this file in [version_no], it requests a password, but I never set one, so the file won't open. It works fine and doesn't ask for a password in the earlier [version_no]. Has anyone experienced this and found a solution? Also, I tried setting a password in [version_no], but it fails, stating there's no existing password to change. Any advice is appreciated. Thanks.
Could you upload your program as a ZIP archive?
Sure. Please try opening it in [version_no]. Thank you.
Here’s a suggestion: The previous version ([version_no]) has program password protection. The newer [product_name] feature in [version_no] asks for a password if one is set in the diagram.
Thanks! I managed to open it in [version_no]. Could you share how you solved the issue?

Your previous program contains a password, which is why you can’t open it in [product_name] [version_no]; the newer version requires you to enter this password. I copied all blocks and comments, created a new empty diagram, and pasted everything in.

analysis.insight_summary: A user experienced an unexpected password prompt when accessing a project created in an earlier [product_name] version using a newer [version_no]. The project could be opened without a password in the old version, but the updated version included a feature that required a password if one was set. Copying blocks and comments into a new diagram served as a workaround, highlighting compatibility and security feature differences between versions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects full compatibility between software versions, especially being able to open and work with files from previous releases without password-related obstacles.
